exceptions.rationale: Multi-header financial report snapshots carry a domain-owned column model and cannot be flattened into the general grid without losing accounting meaning.

review.trigger: A second report adopts the same header/row behavior or the report receives editing.

exceptions.rationale: Fast line entry owns domain row lifecycle, validation and command shape; it may consume field primitives but is not a generic form/table pattern.

review.trigger: Three editors demonstrate an identical non-financial row contract.

exceptions.rationale: Chart rendering is a central specialised presentation adapter with lazy runtime and an accessible HTML summary; it is not a generic card or table.

review.trigger: A new chart type or chart library is proposed.

exceptions.rationale: The bounded share surface uses native disclosure semantics. It must not be replaced with ARIA menu roles until the generic menu contract is implemented and tested.

review.trigger: A second non-disclosure action menu is needed.

exceptions.rationale: Immediate file upload/preview has server authorization and lifecycle behavior beyond BaseerFileInput, which remains the field primitive.

review.trigger: A third upload flow needs the same preview, retry and authorization behavior.
